description: This is a test class for DefaultNotesRepository, utilizing JUnit4 and Kotlin coroutines for testing the note management functionalities in an Android app, including CRUD operations, synchronization, and reactivity.

classes.name: DefaultNotesRepositoryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing DefaultNotesRepository functionalities like creation, deletion, synchronization, conflict resolution, updating, and reactive search updates in an Android environment.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes in-memory database, API mock, and repository before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes the in-memory database after each test.

methods.name: create_updates_flow_and_persists
methods.description: Tests creating a note, observing the flow, and persisting data in the database.

methods.name: delete_tombstone_removes_from_observed_list
methods.description: Verifies that deleting a note removes it from the observed notes list.

methods.name: sync_marks_dirty_clean_and_uploads_to_api
methods.description: Ensures synchronization uploads notes and marks local data as clean.

methods.name: conflict_last_write_wins_prefers_newer_updatedAt
methods.description: Checks that remote updates with newer timestamps override local data.

methods.name: update_preserves_createdAt_and_marks_dirty
methods.description: Verifies that updating a note preserves creation time and marks it as dirty.

methods.name: search_is_reactive_and_filters_by_title_or_content
methods.description: Tests that search is reactive and correctly filters notes based on query.
